skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of phonetics and phonology including definitions of phonetics, phonology, vowels, consonants, phonemes, and suprasegmentals.
Grasp the properties of phonological phenomena such as syllables, stress, phonemes, and intonation in different types of sentences.
Recognize and classify vowels based on their production methods and characteristics.
Identify and classify consonants based on their production methods and characteristics.
Analyze the structure of syllables in monosyllabic and polysyllabic words.
Understand the nature and patterns of stress in words and phrases.
Examine the phenomena of assimilation, reduction, and linking in speech.
Understand the function and types of intonation in spoken language.
Understand the concept and function of pitch accent in spoken language.
Develop the ability to work independently and in groups.
